method: Bounded primary-site pages inspected through web search/open; separate from direct HTTP captures. Self-described independence is not ownership verification or reuse permission.

ea-r1:bdi:iwacu.note: Publisher describes an independent Burundi newsroom. Direct homepage request timed out; no feed admitted.

ea-r1:bdi:sos-medias.note: Journalist-founded Burundi-focused outlet. Ownership and commercial reuse remain unresolved. Advertised feed returned HTML in this capture.

ea-r1:cod:ins-official.note: Primary site identifies INS DRC and offers a statistics portal; do not confuse with Republic of Congo (.cg). Institution/domain succession and usable data endpoint still require review.

ea-r1:dji:human-village.note: Djibouti magazine with local economics, society and ecology reporting; not yet verified as an independently owned daily news publisher.

ea-r1:eri:erena.note: Exile outlet; does not close the domestic independent-news gap. RSF country profile is contextual evidence, not a content source or rights authority.

ea-r1:eri:shabait.note: State information output; never count as independent local journalism.

ea-r1:eri:ministry.note: Same publisher and same feed as Shabait. Role pointer only; no extra diversity or parliamentary coverage claim.

ea-r1:eth:reporter.note: Publisher identifies private ownership by MCC and an Addis Ababa newsroom. Feed recheck failure must not be hidden by initial success.

ea-r1:eth:addis-standard.note: Primary about page and direct robots endpoint blocked; no bypass attempted.

ea-r1:eth:ess-current.note: Discovered current ESS portal; old statsethiopia hostname failure retained separately.

ea-r1:ken:standard.note: Sections 11 and 12 restrict commercial use, automated collection and republication. Initial RSS response exists; no additional XML fetch after terms review. Written permission/approved scope needed.

ea-r1:ken:nation.note: Parent describes independent group and Kenya division. Same group as Monitor and Mwananchi/The Citizen; no cross-country group diversity inflation.

ea-r1:ken:capital-current.note: Old Capital FM about URL redirects to this domain; a second endpoint attempt, not a second publisher.

ea-r1:rwa:ktpress.note: Publisher names Kigali Today Ltd as parent. KT Radio and Kigali Today must not become additional independent publishers. About page also contains unrelated outbound gambling links; integrity review required before admission.

ea-r1:rwa:taarifa.note: Current about page describes independent Rwanda reporting; legacy /about-us/ contains template filler. Terms mention links and attributed short excerpts and route reprints/licensing to publisher. Full-text AI ingestion rights unestablished; no grant inferred from ambiguous extracted wording.

ea-r1:rwa:newtimes.note: Prior registry described feed redirect to homepage. This run skipped the legacy feed under conservative robots policy; do not report historical redirect as a newly observed dead feed.

ea-r1:rwa:rna.note: Current advertised feed is reachable, unlike the historical robots 503. Ownership, independence and reuse remain unverified.

ea-r1:rwa:nisr-apex.note: Canonical apex host responds; www variant has certificate-name mismatch. TLS verification was not disabled.

ea-r1:som:shabelle.note: Publisher describes independent Mogadishu-based media. Public terms located; commercial AI reuse is not established.

ea-r1:ssd:eyeradio.note: Current about page self-describes independent South Sudan reporting. Legacy /about-us/ serves a not-found page. No advertised feed captured.

ea-r1:ssd:tamazuj.note: Publisher states editorial independence; covers South Sudan and Sudan borderlands. Print reprint permission is limited to newspapers in those countries with credit; it is not permission for this product. Sudan is not added to pack membership.

ea-r1:tza:citizen.note: Mwananchi/NMG title. Advertised /tanzania/rss.xml returned 404. Another title from this parent would not close independent publisher diversity.

ea-r1:uga:monitor.note: Monitor Publications is in NMG. Robots 403 prevented direct endpoint verification.

ea-r1:uga:observer.note: Feed accessible; about page inaccessible through web tool. Ownership and rights unresolved.

ea-r1:uga:opm.note: Initial homepage challenge was detected after response; advertised feed returned RSS. Excluded from additional requests and technical readiness pending access-policy review.

countryFindings.BDI: IWACU timeout and SOS Medias HTML feed prevent two usable local feeds. Public broadcaster and Assembly inaccessible; INSBU HTML available; BRB timeout. Red Cross provides humanitarian candidate only.
countryFindings.COD: Actualite.cd and 7sur7 are local candidates with HTML endpoints, not validated feeds. INS old host fails DNS; discovered .gouv.cd portal retained. Parliament inaccessible; ACP truncated. OCHA is humanitarian context, never replacement journalism.
countryFindings.DJI: Only Human Village local magazine candidate found in bounded research; independent ownership and a second publisher unverified. ADI is public news. Gazette feed empty; BCD feed old; INSTAD HTML is not a statistical API. IFRC directory blocked.
countryFindings.ERI: Domestic independent-news COVERAGE_GAP. Erena is exile coverage; Shabait and ministry page are one state publisher. No verified standalone national statistics endpoint found; central-bank candidate inaccessible. IFRC directory blocked. No substitute international news added.
countryFindings.ETH: Addis Standard blocked; Reporter feed initially responds but recheck may fail. Old statistics domain fails; ESS replacement checked. Parliament and disaster commission HTML do not prove structured publication access. ENA timeout retained.
countryFindings.KEN: Deep pack: four local publisher candidates, public broadcaster, Parliament, Treasury, KNBS, CBK, NDMA and Red Cross. Standard rights restricted; Nation blocked; Star challenge; Capital domain migration/endpoint access unresolved. KNBS TLS failure retained. At least two technically and legally verified independent publishers not achieved.
countryFindings.RWA: Deep pack: KT Press, Taarifa, IGIHE, New Times and RNA plus public broadcaster and five institutional candidates. KT group identity known but independence not established; Taarifa self-description not ownership verification. RNA now offers RSS. IGIHE blocked, New Times feed skipped under robots rules, BNR HTML only. NISR apex resolves www TLS problem; government robots restrictions retained.
countryFindings.SOM: Shabelle feed plus Goobjoog HTML candidate do not establish two rights-cleared independent publishers. SONNA challenged, Parliament feed empty, CBS 403; SNBS and SoDMA offer feed candidates. Keep statistics separate from news and emergency advisories separate from independent reporting.
countryFindings.SSD: Eye Radio HTML and Tamazuj feed are self-described independent; Tamazuj is cross-border and print permission is not product permission. Legislature DNS failure; national statistics hostname needs identity review. BoSS publications and OCHA context cannot close journalism gaps.
countryFindings.TZA: Citizen advertised feed 404; IPP blocked; Daily News robots 500. Parliament response truncated; NBS and BoT HTML available; PMO connection reset. Do not add Mwananchi as a supposedly separate independent group from Citizen.
countryFindings.UGA: Observer feed candidate and Monitor robots block leave independent diversity/rights unresolved. UBC is public broadcaster; UBOS TLS failure, Parliament and BoU HTML only. OPM challenge means its captured feed is not access-policy cleared.
